payload.summary: CME/On Call visual polish still open after the 2026-09-24 audit
payload.detail: (1) CME annual summary is an unstyled 10,000px text wall on a phone (cme-annual-summary.tsx) - give it cards/table styling on screen, keep print CSS. (2) Routine edit form renders above the page title off-screen with a second h1 (cme-routines-route.tsx:126-201). (3) A due routine takes the dashboard's only next-action slot, hiding unmet requirements; no 'skip this one'. (4) Contact rows have ragged right columns and ~150px stale rows. (5) Small tap targets: card numbers (17px), 'Watch recording' (19px), 'Your evidence' (16px). (6) /on-call/service signed-out view has no h1 and no page menu. (7) Pocket card repeats its title in header and hero. (8) Recent rows on the On Call home use a raw <a> for internal routes (full reload).
payload.source: On Call + CME audit 2026-09-24 (code read + demo-mode screenshots, branch claude/on-call-cme-audit-gltczi)
